await (async(page)=>{
const c=await page.context().browser().newContext({locale:'en-US'});const events=[];const p=await c.newPage();
try{await p.goto('https://www.duolingo.com/course/es/en/Learn-Spanish');await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Get started',exact:true}).first().click();await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true}).waitFor({timeout:30000});
for(let i=0;i<20;i++){
 let ready=false; let selectedGroup=null; const end=Date.now()+30000;
 while(Date.now()<end){
  if(await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Check',exact:true}).count()){ready=true;break;}
  for(const re of [/^Other$/,/new to Spanish/,/^5 min.*Casual$/,/^Start from scratch/]){
   const r=p.getByRole('radio',{name:re});if(await r.count()===1&&await r.isVisible()&&await r.isEnabled()&&!await r.isChecked()){selectedGroup=await r.evaluate(el=>el.closest('[role="radiogroup"]').getAttribute('aria-label'));await r.click();break;}
  }
  const block=p.getByRole('button',{name:'Block',exact:true});const next=p.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true}).last();
  if(await block.count()&&await block.isVisible()||await next.count()&&await next.isEnabled()){ready=true;break;}
  await p.waitForTimeout(100);
 }
 events.push(await p.locator('body').ariaSnapshot());if(!ready)throw Error("no recognized actionable onboarding state");
 if(await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Check',exact:true}).count())break;
 const text=await p.locator('body').innerText(); const block=p.getByRole('button',{name:'Block',exact:true});
 if(await block.count()&&await block.isVisible()){await block.click();}else{await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true}).last().click();}
 if(selectedGroup){await p.getByRole("radiogroup",{name:selectedGroup,exact:true}).waitFor({state:"hidden",timeout:30000});}else{await p.waitForFunction(old=>document.body.innerText!==old,text,{timeout:30000});}
}return {events};
}catch(e){return {error:e.message,events,final:await p.locator('body').ariaSnapshot()};}finally{await c.close();}})(page);
